title: Execute one authorized VA service-connection provider request
originating_goal: Perform one real source-grounded service_connection request only after fresh TVC admission, protected Master Records configuration, explicit bounded provider authority, and the hosted PII runtime gate all pass in the same execution run.
required_sequence: Validate the hosted PII runtime PASS receipt and exact runtime/dispatcher commits.
Route every submitted question and derived context through va_claim_assistant/privacy_guarded_dispatch.py before classifier invocation, authority consumption, provider permission, or model input.
Reject any REVIEW_REQUIRED privacy result without requesting provider permission and without retaining rejected values or hashes.
Validate an unexpired exact-commit VA provider authority receipt.
Obtain a fresh single-use 900-second TVC admission in the same workflow run.
Verify protected Master Records endpoint, allowed-host, and token bindings without logging values.
Consume both authority records before provider permission is requested.
Request models: read only in the single execution job.
Perform at most one retrieval-grounded provider request with maximum cost USD 0.10.
Persist a privacy-minimized execution receipt bound to the privacy event, TVC, answer, dispatch, provider, usage, custody, and reconstruction evidence.
Require the existing execution observer to emit COMPLETE.
Transfer the execution and privacy receipts to master-records/orchestration#15 and Site#113.
expected_evidence: The privacy event is PASS and hash-bound before any provider permission or model input.
Provider used exactly once with approved model and endpoint.
No credential value, prompt, raw model text, PII, raw document, identity artifact, trace, prohibited log, or medical narrative enters the retained receipt.
Answer and dispatch hashes match the admitted service_connection route.
Provider usage is persisted and authenticated custody returns RECORDED.
Transition custody returns RECORDED and reconstruction returns PASS.
Every authority and activation effect remains false.
collision_boundaries: Do not modify or dispatch the Ecosystem Chat execution workflow owned by issue #18.
Do not execute from push, schedule, pull_request, credential presence, or privacy PASS alone.
Do not create or approve the authority receipt from the execution lane.
Do not bypass privacy_guarded_dispatch or send rejected input to a provider.
Do not exceed one provider request or USD 0.10.
Do not activate Site, filing, submission, representation, adjudication, rating, medical opinion, publication, deployment, or release.
next_executable_action: An authorized configuration/authority owner must make the protected Master Records endpoint, allowed-hosts, token, and exact-caller VA provider authority valid. The six-hour preflight observer will then emit READY_FOR_EXPLICIT_AUTHORIZED_EXECUTION; only then may the execution lane be claimed and installed/executed.
